_comment: Stage 4C - Preface. The threshold test replaces the interruption test: inside a chapter another voice must earn the interruption; at the entrance it must earn the privilege of greeting the reader first. Legitimate reasons to stay: it establishes lineage the book genuinely belongs to, it creates a threshold the Preface then fulfils, or it introduces a question the book immediately takes up.

entries.match: May what I do flow from me like a river
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - THRESHOLD, AND THE PREFACE FULFILS IT. The pages that follow are the author as a boy in the woods and the loss of exactly that unforced flow. Verified exact, and the census's first translator-naming entry to pass the printed-English test: the rights-relevant object is the Barrows-Macy English, which the bibliography correctly cites. Rights likely_protected_high - Stage 6.

entries.match: when we no longer know what to do we have come to our real work
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - INTRODUCES THE QUESTION THE BOOK IMMEDIATELY TAKES UP. The Preface goes straight to the author's youthful questions about his parents' unhappiness; not-knowing as the entrance to real work is the book's own premise. PROVENANCE RECOVERY OWED: the census recorded rights only for this record and deliberately did not infer a provenance verdict. A Preface epigraph greeting the reader is the wrong place to carry an unchecked citation, so this goes near the front of the Stage 6 queue rather than the back.
entries.recovery_note: Provenance verdict never established. Verify the wording and source of Wendell Berry's 'The Real Work' before publication; rights likely_protected_high, poetry, living author.
entries.evidence_location: QUOTATION_PROVENANCE_AUDIT.md rights table (rights only, no provenance narrative); 4C Preface ruling

entries.match: These things are skillful, blameless, praised by sensible people
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - THRESHOLD / EPISTEMIC LINEAGE. It earns the privilege of greeting the reader because the Preface immediately answers it: test what you are given against experience. That is not borrowed gravitas; it establishes the epistemic relationship the book wants with its reader. It is also the one genuine Buddha item among the five fake ones now removed. REPAIR APPLIED at the source closure pass: the printed paraphrase was replaced with Bhikkhu Sujato's verbatim rendering of AN 3.65, so the English is now sourced, CC0-licensed, and carries the sutta's actual criterion.
